description.value: Formerly known as Arigato Sushi, this Japanese restaurant rebranded as Miso Sushi in March 2026, while retaining the same menu and staff. It sits directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Valleyview area of Kamloops, making it a convenient stop for cyclists traveling that corridor. Online ordering is available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms the business is open and operating at 1821 Trans-Canada Hwy, Kamloops. However, the business has rebranded from 'Arigato Sushi' (the OSM name) to 'Miso Sushi' as of March 2026, per the website header 'Miso Sushi (Formerly Arigato Sushi)'. The page title includes 'Order Online', indicating takeout is available; no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Business has rebranded: OSM name is 'Arigato Sushi' but the website clearly shows the current name is 'Miso Sushi' (rebrand effective March 2026). OSM record should be updated.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only — no OSM values to cross-check against.
Website domain (arigato-valleyview.ca) still reflects the old brand name; may change in future.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Japanese restaurant on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops — a useful stop for touring cyclists. Business is confirmed operating under a new name as of March 2026.
